subject: Capacity realignment request + proposed dedicated resize and burst plan
messages:
From: Alex Reyes <alex@tidescale.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity realignment request ahead of renewal

Hi Ben,

Quick note from our ops team: over the last 6 weeks we've been seeing sustained GPU utilization of ~68–75% on our Dedicated pool (8x A100 reserved), and a couple of mid-day latency spikes when we run batch re-ranks. Renewal is up in August and we'd like to discuss either adding capacity or changing the tranche to avoid throttling during peak windows.

Attached is our May usage export (tidescale_usage_May2027.csv) and a short chart of daily peak utilization. Our tolerance for tail latency is low — customer-facing endpoints need to stay sub-150ms P95 for small prompts.

Can we schedule a short call this week to review options? Prefer mornings PT.

Thanks,
Alex Reyes
Head of Infrastructure, TideScale
alex@tidescale.ai

--
Attachment: tidescale_usage_May2027.csv (CSV, 42 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reyes <alex@tidescale.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity realignment request ahead of renewal

Alex — thanks for the data and the clear ask. I pulled this into a quick sketch for options. High level we can: 1) add +4 A100s to move from 8->12 reserved, 2) introduce a small burst pool (on-demand H100/A100 mix) to absorb peak spikes, or 3) opt for a mixed sizing: +2 reserved + burst credits while we evaluate usage for one billing cycle.

I'll loop in Karthik for pricing/commit implications and Priyom for the ops/config impact. If you're open, I'd propose we: (a) provision +2 reserved GPUs today, (b) enable a 10% burst pool for 60 days, and (c) schedule an infra sync to evaluate P95 improvement — if spikes persist we accelerate to +4 reserved.

Can you confirm the top priority is keeping P95 <150ms (yes/no) and whether TideScale has any procurement or PO timing constraints ahead of August renewal?

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm priority and procurement window (Alex)
- Redwood to share an amended quote and capacity playbook (Ben)
- Technical review to pick exact instance mix (Priyom + TideScale infra)

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

--
Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c_tidescale-capacity-plan

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity realignment request ahead of renewal

Folks — looked at Alex's usage file. A few notes:
- Sustained ~70% on 8xA100 suggests headroom is thin, but a full +4 reservation is a heavier pricing commitment.
- Quick win: we can push quantization and KV cache tuning on their most-used models; that would reduce tokens/sec and alleviate hot-path load by ~10–20% (estimate).
- Recommended commercial approach: offer a 2-step amendment: +2 reserved GPUs with pricing scaled annually, plus a short-term burst credit add-on (30–60 days) at a smaller incremental cost. If utilization stays >65% under tuned model, convert to +4 reserved at a pre-agreed price (clause in amendment).

I've attached a pricing sketch (tranche_pricing_v3.pdf) with the fallback clause language. This keeps TideScale flexibility and avoids them overcommitting now.

Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: tranche_pricing_v3.pdf (PDF, 128 KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Alex Reyes <alex@tidescale.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity realignment request ahead of renewal

Alex — copying you so TideScale infra can see the ops proposal. Operationally I'd recommend the mixed-instance approach:
- Add +2 reserved (A100) to raise steady-state capacity,
- Spin up 2 H100 instances in burst pool for latency-critical endpoints (cheaper P95),
- Autoscaling thresholds: trigger burst when queue length > 12 requests OR sustained P95 degradation for 3 consecutive 5-min windows,
- Cache/prefix tuning for models (Karthik's team can provide the prompt-level checklist),
- 30–60 day evaluation window with telemetry retention for rollback decisions.

I've attached a capacity workbook with region placement and cost delta (capacity_plan_v2.xlsx). On SLAs: enabling burst will reduce P95 tail risk but we should note that burst is billed differently and doesn't change base commit.

If TideScale approves, I can prepare the exact instance mix and an ops runbook for the technical review.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

--
Attachment: capacity_plan_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 220 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reyes <alex@tidescale.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity realignment request ahead of renewal

Alex — thanks for the quick turn. Based on the ops + pricing feedback above, here's the agreed next step proposal for TideScale:

1) Commercial: 2x A100 reserved added immediately to your Dedicated pool; amended quote attached (amended_quote_TD-2027-411.pdf). We include a conditional convert-to-4 clause if utilization stays above 65% for the 30-day post-change window.
2) Burst: enable a 2-node burst pool (H100 preferred for P95-sensitive routes) for 60 days; burst will be billed separately as usage.
3) Technical: schedule a 60-minute runbook review next Tuesday 10am PT — Priyom & Karthik will join.
4) DocuSign: I'll send the amendment via DocuSign; please sign by Monday 25 Jun to ensure provisioning before August renewal. Link: https://www.docusign.net/envelope/TIDE-TD-2027-411

Please reply with OK to proceed and confirm the 10am PT slot or propose alternatives. If anything here looks off I can rework the clause language.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
